articles.title: Lanterns Funko POPs Reveal First Look At Sinestro And Hal Jordan Fully Suited-Up
articles.summary: A new trailer for 'Lanterns' is set for release tomorrow at San Diego Comic-Con. Ahead of this, a first look at revealing tie-in Funko POPs, featuring characters like John St..., has been provided. This news highlights the entertainment industry's use of major conventions to generate buzz for upcoming media releases and merchandise, targeting a global audience.

articles.title: Shoppers may see higher oil prices surface through groceries, back-to-school items
articles.summary: Global oil prices surged past $100 a barrel due to intensified fighting related to the Iran war. This geopolitical instability is causing significant concern for consumers, who are already experiencing financial strain. The ongoing conflict highlights the critical link between international security and global economic stability, impacting daily lives worldwide.

articles.title: 'First cheque is never just capital, it's belief': Skyroot's Pawan Kumar on angel investor Mukesh Bansal
articles.summary: Skyroot Aerospace cofounder Pawan Kumar Chandana thanked angel investor Mukesh Bansal for crucial early backing, instrumental in the spacetech startup's historic success. This underscores the vital role of private investment in propelling India's burgeoning space sector. Such partnerships are key for national progress, fostering innovation and achieving self-reliance in cutting-edge technologies like space exploration.

articles.title: Ukraine's ousted defence minister insists on being reinstated
articles.summary: Fedorov, appointed defence minister in January, announced on Thursday that his team has a 'specific plan how to end the war.' He indicated this strategy was ready when he took office, with its core elements focused on ensuring protection. This statement highlights a proactive governmental approach to resolving an ongoing conflict, emphasizing strategic planning from the defence sector to achieve peace.

articles.title: “Lanterns” Trailer Tomorrow & New Story Details
articles.summary: DC Studios and HBO will host a panel for their new "Lanterns" series at Comic-Con's Hall H tomorrow. Simultaneously, the full trailer for the anticipated series will debut online. This major announcement offers fans significant insight into the upcoming show, reflecting the global reach of these entertainment giants and the international impact of such Comic-Con events.

articles.title: Big success: DRDO develops India’s first expendable turbojet engine of 350 kg thrust class; tech mastered by only a few nations
articles.summary: India has achieved a significant milestone in indigenous defence technology with the successful development of its first expendable turbojet engine. This engine, designed for a 350 kg thrust class, marks a major success in jet propulsion technology. This advancement will bolster India's self-reliance and capabilities in critical aerospace and defence sectors, crucial for future strategic applications.

articles.title: Algonquin chiefs upset with Hydro-Québec compensation talks
articles.summary: Chiefs of four Algonquin First Nations are upset with Hydro-Québec over its perceived disinterest in resolving a decades-old compensation claim. The dispute concerns the damming of a crucial watershed, impacting their ancestral lands and resources. This issue underscores ongoing challenges in indigenous rights and resource management within Canada, highlighting the importance of equitable reconciliation efforts.
